title: Interactive Retry Origins Lens — payload-first error analysis
creator: Priya Patel
description: Design an interactive "Retry Origins Lens" for Redwood Console that prioritizes payload inspection and causal grouping for failed requests. The lens helps engineers quickly determine whether failures are client-, infra-, or model-originated, whether retries are likely to succeed, and which retry policy would have helped. This ticket delivers high-fidelity wireframes, an interactive Figma prototype, acceptance criteria, and a short usability test plan.
problem_statement: When SREs and product engineers investigate failures in the Console they often jump between timelines, raw payloads, and logs. Existing views surface individual failed requests but lack a compact view that groups root-cause signals (model error types, infra signals, rate limit hits) and shows which retries changed outcomes. This leads to slow RCA and repeated rollout oscillations.
goals: Surface a compact summary that attributes failure origin (client / infra / model / rate-limit / downstream)
Show retry outcome correlation: for each grouped error class, what fraction recovered after retry and why
Enable payload-first inspection: quick diff of user prompt + model output before/after retry, with KV-cache hints
Provide inline suggested mitigations (increase timeout, backoff, switch model variant) tied to policy templates
Ship a Figma prototype and acceptance criteria for handoff to ENG
non_goals: Full automatic root-cause classification (ML classifier is out of scope)
Rebuilding the entire request explorer; this is a targeted lens that lives on top of existing request lists
Implementing backend automated remediation or rollback flows (UI-only design & small integration points)
user_flows: Error triage: user starts from per-route dashboard -> clicks "Open Retry Lens" -> sees grouped error cards -> expands one card to inspect payload diffs and timeline scrubber
Deep inspect: user filters by timeframe and model variant, drills into a specific request to open a payload panel with before/after retry toggles and structured field highlighting
Policy authoring: user selects a failed-group and clicks 'Suggest policy' to see recommended retry/backoff/variant rules and export to rollout
wireframe_notes: Top header: summary row with total failed requests, retry-success %, dominant origin
Left column: group list (error classes) sorted by impact (failed count * deployment risk score)
Center: timeline heatmap of retries over time with hover showing sample payloads
Right: payload lens panel that highlights changed tokens, response codes, and model logits snapshot (when available)
Inline CTA: 'Export as rollout' and 'Pin to investigation' buttons
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates the full happy-path: group selection -> timeline scrub -> payload diff -> suggested policy modal
Edge-case flows: group with >10k events still renders an aggregated summary and paginated sample list
Payload diff highlights token-level changes for model responses and shows HTTP header differences for infra errors
Design tokens and spacing conform to Console design system (token names included in handoff file)
Accessibility: keyboard focus order for lens panels validated; color contrast >= 4.5:1 for key severity states
design_decisions: Use a grouped-card pattern instead of a flat list to make root-cause comparisons faster
Prioritize payload diffs over raw logs for user-facing RCA because it surfaces actionable changes (prompt vs response) quicker
Show retry correlation as both percentage and an absolute timeline sparkline to avoid misinterpretation on low-volume groups
Keep policy suggestions conservative (backoff + one variant fallback) to reduce risk of aggressive automatic rollouts
risks_and_open_questions: How reliable are model-origin signals without a backend classifier? We'll rely on heuristic rules (status codes, known patterns) initially
Sampling: for high-volume routes, what sampling strategy preserves signal without flooding the UI? Need ENG input
Privacy: does payload diffing expose sensitive PII? Work with privacy to define redaction rules
Performance: rendering large token diffs can be slow; consider server-side precomputed deltas or progressive hydration
review_feedback: PM Lauren Kim: prefer explicit 'confidence' metric for origin attribution (low/medium/high)
SRE Evan Brooks: add option to overlay capacity/events from infra telemetry on the timeline
Design Aisha Chen: simplify the right-hand panel — collapse logs behind an 'Advanced' section
Security Mateo Alvarez: require redaction toggle and audit log entry when viewing full payloads

accessibility_considerations: Ensure keyboard navigation between group cards and payload lens. Provide text alternatives for timeline heatmaps and use color + icon for severity states. Include redaction states and confirm screen-reader announcements when toggling sensitive payload visibility.
usability_test_plan: Recruit 6 engineers (3 infra, 3 product/platform). Tasks: identify dominant failure origin for a simulated outage; pick a suggested policy and export to rollout; explain why a retry succeeded for a sample request. Metrics: task completion, time-to-insight, qualitative confusion points.
customer_impact_explanation: This lens reduces mean time to resolution for transient and model-origin failures by surfacing retry correlations and payload deltas. Immediate beneficiaries: platform teams and internal SREs; downstream customer value is faster incident mitigation and fewer escalations.
